worldcombat.skill.focuspunch.summary: Plant yourself and gather your power into one fist; any external damage during the gather scatters it, and the punch lands only after the gather finishes.
worldcombat.skill.focuspunch.use.0: Gather a crushing blow while the foe cannot reach you
worldcombat.skill.focuspunch.use.1: Punish a target already tied up by an ally
worldcombat.skill.focuspunch.use.2: Force the foe to decide whether to step into your long wind-up
worldcombat.skill.focuspunch.description: After gathering for %2$s, punch for %1$s power; any external damage taken during the gather scatters the punch.
Fist reach %1$s blocks, lunge %2$s blocks/tick, hit radius %3$s blocks; the target is shoved back %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.focuspunch.steady.on: Steady stance on: gather x1.35 and punch x1.12, but the longer wind-up breaks more easily, recovery +3 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.focuspunch.steady.off: Steady stance off: a shorter gather and a faster punch, slightly lighter, but harder to catch mid-wind-up.
worldcombat.skill.focuspunch.timing: Cast on an enemy within %1$s blocks; after gathering for %2$s it spends %4$s PP; recovery %3$s, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.focuspunch.growth.0: At level %1$s the punch rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.focuspunch.growth.1: At level %1$s the punch rises to %2$s and the reach extends to %3$s.
On: gather x1.35 and punch x1.12, but a longer, more interruptible wind-up, recovery +3 ticks, cooldown +8 ticks. Off: shorter gather, faster punch, slightly lighter.
Only consider gathering when the foe is this close; raising it starts the stance earlier but the long gather whiffs more.
On: hold the gather for a few seconds after taking a hit, and start once that exchange passes. Off: gather even right after being hit, gambling the blow will miss.
